# Still Wild Safaris

> Bespoke luxury safari experiences in Uganda, Rwanda and Kenya. Expert-guided gorilla trekking, wildlife safaris and cultural journeys.

Still Wild Safaris designs private, expert-guided safaris across Uganda, Rwanda and Kenya, including gorilla and chimpanzee trekking, Big Five game drives, and tailor-made itineraries with hand-selected luxury and mid-range lodges.

## Safari Collections

- [2 Days from Rwanda to the Mountain Gorillas](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/2-day-rwanda-gorilla): The shortest route to Africa's most extraordinary wildlife encounter — Kigali to Bwindi in one seamless luxury journey.
- [3 Days from Kigali into Gorilla Country](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/3-day-kigali-gorilla): Track mountain gorillas in their natural habitat — the classic Uganda experience via Rwanda's scenic route.
- [A 4-Day Rwanda–Uganda Primate Safari](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/4-day-rwanda-uganda-primate): Two of Africa's most extraordinary primates — golden monkeys and mountain gorillas — in one unforgettable journey.
- [5 Days from Kigali Among Uganda's Great Apes](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/5-day-kigali-great-apes): Uganda's ultimate primates double-header — gorillas and chimpanzees in one immersive journey.
- [3-Day Classic Uganda Gorilla Safari](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/3-day-classic-uganda-gorilla): The iconic journey into the heart of the Pearl of Africa — Entebbe to Bwindi via the Equator.
- [3-Day Gorilla Safari Kigali to Uganda](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/3-day-kigali-uganda-gorilla): A premium cross-border experience — bypass the long Entebbe drive and arrive at Bwindi in just 4 hours.
- [4-Day Luxury Uganda Gorilla Trekking (Fly-In)](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/4-day-luxury-flyin-gorilla): Maximum comfort, minimum travel — the premium fly-in gorilla experience from Entebbe.
- [8-Day Western Circuit Primate & Wildlife](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/8-day-western-circuit-primate): The ultimate primate odyssey — chimps, gorillas, and tree-climbing lions across Uganda's western circuit.
- [10-Day Grand Uganda Safari The Complete Loop](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/10-day-grand-uganda-safari): A grand expedition through the Pearl of Africa's finest parks — rhinos, falls, chimps, lions, and gorillas.
- [Rhythm & Roots A 9-Day Creative Safari](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/9-day-rhythm-roots): Nine days in the sound, story, and soul of Uganda — for musicians, writers, and performers.
- [Uganda Primate & Fishing Safari — 11 Days](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/11-day-primate-fishing): World-class fishing and extraordinary primate encounters across Uganda's most pristine wilderness.
- [7-Day Shoebill & Primates Fly-In Safari](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/7-day-shoebill-primates): From prehistoric Shoebills to great primates — a specialist fly-in expedition for birders and wildlife lovers.
- [The Deep Dive 12-Day Creative Residency](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/deep-dive-creative): Come with a project. Leave with work. A field residency for filmmakers, writers, and visual artists across Uganda's wildest terrain.
- [The Wild Muse 7-Day Creative Safari](https://stillwildsafaris.com/safari-collections/wild-muse-creative): Seven days of sensory immersion designed to fill the creative well — for visual artists, photographers, and illustrators.

## Destinations

- [Uganda](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda): In the heart of equatorial Africa, where the Nile begins its legendary journey northward and ancient forests shelter half the world's remaining mountain gorillas, Uganda emerges as a destination of extraordinary, intimate wilderness. We invite you to be changed by it.
  - [Entebbe](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/entebbe): Uganda's serene lakeside gateway on the shores of Lake Victoria — home to the international airport, a wildlife education centre, and Ngamba Island's rescued chimpanzees, this is where almost every Uganda safari quietly begins and ends.
  - [Kampala](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/kampala): Uganda's vibrant capital, built across seven hills on the shores of Lake Victoria — a sprawling, energetic city of royal tombs, buzzing markets and vibrant culture that rewards every traveller who slows down long enough to explore it.
  - [Bwindi Impenetrable National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/bwindi): Home to roughly half the world's remaining mountain gorillas, this UNESCO World Heritage Site protects 331 km² of ancient Albertine Rift rainforest — one of the most extraordinary wildlife destinations on the planet, where a face-to-face encounter with a wild gorilla family changes you forever.
  - [Queen Elizabeth National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/queen-elizabeth): Uganda's most visited and ecologically complex park — tree-climbing lions in Ishasha, the wildlife-dense Kazinga Channel, chimpanzee trekking in Kyambura Gorge, and over 600 bird species across 1,978 km² of Albertine Rift wilderness.
  - [Murchison Falls National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/murchison-falls): Uganda's largest national park — where the entire volume of the Victoria Nile is forced through a 7-metre gorge in the world's most powerful waterfall, then fans into a wildlife-rich delta on Lake Albert. Lions, Rothschild's giraffes, elephants, and shoebill storks across 3,840 km².
  - [Kibale National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/kibale): The primate capital of the world — 13 species in a single park, including over 1,500 chimpanzees in some of the most accessible and best-studied communities in Africa. Kibale is Uganda's premier chimpanzee trekking destination.
  - [Lake Mburo National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/lake-mburo): Uganda's walking safari capital — the only national park in the country offering walking, cycling, and horse-riding safaris through open African savannah. Zebras, impalas, hippos, and leopards on night drives, perfectly positioned between Kampala and Bwindi.
  - [Mgahinga Gorilla National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/mgahinga): A small park dominated by three Virunga volcanoes, home to mountain gorillas and the only park in Uganda where you can track golden monkeys.
  - [Kidepo Valley National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/kidepo-valley): Uganda's most remote and most rewarding safari destination — 1,442 km² of dramatic semi-arid savannah in the far northeast, with cheetahs, wild dogs, lions, and Karamojong warrior culture in a park that receives very few visitors.
  - [Semuliki National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/uganda/semuliki): Uganda's most underrated national park — ancient Congo Basin rainforest, boiling Sempaya Hot Springs, and 441 bird species including 40 Congo Basin endemics found nowhere else in East Africa. The most important forest birding destination in Uganda.
- [Rwanda](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda): Beyond the mist-shrouded peaks of the Virunga Mountains, Rwanda is Africa's most remarkable conservation success story and one of its most sophisticated travel destinations. From intimate gorilla encounters in ancient volcanic forests to Big Five savannah in Akagera, Rwanda rewards those who travel with both curiosity and conscience.
  - [Volcanoes National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda/volcanoes): The Rwandan section of the Virunga Massif — a chain of ancient volcanoes cloaked in bamboo and rainforest, sanctuary to some of the last remaining mountain gorillas on the planet and a thriving population of golden monkeys.
  - [Akagera National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda/akagera): Africa's most successful conservation comeback story — savannahs, papyrus swamps and lakes restored to a full Big Five reserve since 2010, with reintroduced lions and rhinos thriving alongside elephants, leopards and buffalo.
  - [Kigali](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda/kigali): Africa's cleanest, safest and most captivating capital — a city of immaculate streets, profound history, world-class dining and forward momentum that defies every expectation. The essential gateway to gorilla trekking, and a destination in its own right.
  - [Nyungwe Forest National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda/nyungwe): One of Africa's oldest and most biodiverse rainforests — 1,019 km² of ancient montane forest home to 13 primate species including chimpanzees, and the iconic canopy walkway suspended 70 metres above the forest floor.
  - [Lake Kivu](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/rwanda/lake-kivu): One of Africa's Great Lakes — a deep mountain lake at 1,460m above sea level, entirely safe for swimming, fringed by volcanic hills, island archipelagos, and Rwanda's most beautiful lakeside resort towns.
- [Kenya](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya): Where else on earth does a single horizon contain a million wildebeest, a pride of lions in golden light, and a hot-air balloon drifting silently at dawn? Kenya is Africa's most storied safari destination — and for those who know where to look, it remains a place of profound, unhurried discovery.
  - [Masai Mara National Reserve](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/masai-mara): The northern extension of the Serengeti and the stage for the Great Migration each July to October — plus year-round resident lion, leopard and cheetah on Africa's most photographed plains.
  - [Amboseli National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/amboseli): The classic 'elephants under Kilimanjaro' park — small, accessible, and home to some of Africa's largest tuskers in front of an impossibly photogenic mountain backdrop.
  - [Laikipia & Loisaba](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/laikipia): A 9,500 km² conservancy mosaic north of Mount Kenya — home to half of Kenya's black rhino, all of its Grevy's zebras, and some of the most innovative community-led conservation work in Africa.
  - [Samburu National Reserve](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/samburu): Kenya's remote northern frontier — home to the Samburu Special Five (Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, gerenuk, beisa oryx and Somali ostrich) found nowhere else in the region, in a dramatic landscape defined by the Ewaso Ng'iro River.
  - [Tsavo National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/tsavo): Kenya's largest park — a vast, red-earth wilderness famous for its 'red elephants' coated in Tsavo's distinctive dust, and for raw, uncrowded wildness.
  - [Lake Nakuru National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/lake-nakuru): A compact soda lake sanctuary in the heart of the Great Rift Valley — famous for its dramatic flamingo flocks, Kenya's best rhino viewing, and remarkable wildlife diversity packed into just 188 square kilometres.
  - [Nairobi](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/kenya/nairobi): Africa's safari capital — a dynamic metropolis where lions and rhinos roam in a national park on the city's doorstep, elephant orphans are bottle-fed at 11am, and giraffes join guests for breakfast.
- [Tanzania](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania): No country holds as much concentrated, uninterrupted wilderness as Tanzania. From the infinite Serengeti where 1.5 million wildebeest move in ancient circular rhythm, to the world's largest intact volcanic caldera at Ngorongoro, the remote wild south, and the spice-scented Indian Ocean coast of Zanzibar — Tanzania is not merely a safari. It is the Earth in its most original state.
  - [Serengeti National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/serengeti): The greatest wildlife spectacle on earth — 1.5 million wildebeest and 350,000 zebra crossing an endless plain, with lion, leopard and cheetah in extraordinary numbers year-round.
  - [Ngorongoro Conservation Area](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/ngorongoro): An ancient, collapsed caldera sheltering the densest concentration of wildlife in Africa — the world's largest intact volcanic crater and home to all of the Big Five in a single enclosed ecosystem.
  - [Nyerere National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/nyerere): Africa's largest national park — a vast, wild, boat-safari heartland of the Rufiji River, famous for African wild dogs, hippos and a remote, uncrowded safari atmosphere.
  - [Rubondo Island National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/rubondo): An island wilderness on Lake Victoria — chimp habituation, forest walks, fishing, and a cast of reintroduced species in one of Africa's most unusual and uncrowded national parks.
  - [Arusha](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/arusha): Tanzania's safari capital and gateway to the northern circuit — a lively highland city beneath Mount Meru, with a half-day safari on its own doorstep, world-famous Tanzanite, and easy connections to the Serengeti, Ngorongoro and Kilimanjaro.
  - [Kilimanjaro National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/kilimanjaro): Africa's highest mountain and the world's highest walkable peak — a snow-capped 5,895m volcanic massif rising from the Tanzanian plains to Uhuru Peak, reached via five ecological zones and a choice of legendary trekking routes.
  - [Lake Manyara National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/lake-manyara): A compact Rift Valley gem famous for tree-climbing lions, flamingo-filled soda-lake shores, and a groundwater forest of primates — Ernest Hemingway's 'Green Hills of Africa' and the perfect opening chapter to a northern Tanzania circuit.
  - [Tarangire National Park](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/tarangire): Tanzania's most underrated wildlife destination — ancient baobab-studded plains and dry-season elephant herds of 200-300 individuals along the Tarangire River, with a fraction of the Serengeti's crowds.
  - [Zanzibar Archipelago](https://stillwildsafaris.com/destinations/tanzania/zanzibar): Africa's most romantic island destination — the UNESCO-listed lanes of Stone Town, spice plantations that once made the island fabulously wealthy, and Indian Ocean beaches ranging from calm northern shores to kitesurfing hotspots in the east.

## Experiences

- [Gorilla Trekking](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/gorilla-trekking): Journey into the mist-shrouded forests of Uganda and Rwanda for a profound, luxury encounter with mountain gorillas.
- [Chimpanzee Trekking](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/chimpanzee-trekking): Witness the captivating intelligence of chimpanzees in their natural habitat in Uganda's Kibale or Rwanda's Nyungwe Forest.
- [Golden Monkey Trekking](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/golden-monkey-trekking): Seek out the elusive and vibrant golden monkeys in Uganda's Mgahinga or Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park for a captivating wildlife experience.
- [White Water Rafting](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/white-water-rafting): Conquer world-class rapids at the source of the Nile in Jinja, Uganda, with luxury rafting packages.
- [Boat Cruise Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/boat-cruise-safaris): Glide along Uganda's Kazinga Channel, Murchison Falls, or Kenya's Lake Naivasha for intimate wildlife viewing.
- [Hot Air Balloon Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/hot-air-balloon): Drift silently above the Serengeti or Masai Mara at sunrise, ending in a celebratory bush breakfast.
- [Cultural Experiences](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/cultural-experiences): Immerse yourself in East Africa's living cultures — Batwa, Maasai, Karamojong and many more.
- [Helicopter Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/helicopter-safaris): Private aerial tours and remote landings across East Africa's most spectacular landscapes.
- [Fly-In Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/fly-in-safaris): Private bush flights to opulent lodges and aerial views of iconic national parks.
- [Walking Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/walking-safaris): Guided by expert armed rangers through Laikipia or Selous to track wildlife on foot.
- [Classic Game Drives](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/classic-game-drives): Private 4×4s and expert guides through Serengeti, Masai Mara, or Ngorongoro Crater.
- [Night Game Drives](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/night-game-drives): Spot elusive nocturnal predators with expert trackers and specialised equipment.
- [Wellness Retreats](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/wellness-spa): Yoga on savannah decks, indigenous spa treatments, and full retreats inside your safari.
- [Private Island Escapes](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/private-island-escapes): Marine safaris, private beach dinners, and bespoke luxury in pristine coastal havens.
- [Conservation Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/conservation-safaris): Behind-the-scenes access and direct contribution to wildlife protection and monitoring.
- [Horseback Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/horseback-safaris): Ride alongside giraffes and zebras with luxury mobile fly-camps and expert equestrian guides.
- [Photographic Safaris](https://stillwildsafaris.com/experiences/photographic-safaris): Custom-built vehicles and professional photographer guides to capture stunning wildlife imagery.
